references.text: Psalm 41:1-3 speaks of the blessing of caring for the weak, which reflects Jesus' message in Matthew 25:45 about serving the least as service to him.
Hebrews 13:2-3 encourages hospitality and care for prisoners as if they were Christ himself, paralleling the idea of serving Christ by serving the least in Matthew 25:45.
James 1:27 defines pure and undefiled religion as caring for orphans and widows in their distress, which resonates with Jesus' call to serve the least in Matthew 25:45.
